headlines.text: On a Saturday in 2023, back when Samoa Joe vs. Penta El Zero M met in a Tournament Match, closing out the card as the main event on Collision, rated 7.18 ? a good, competitive contest.

Rewind to 2020, when the AEW TNT Title was up for grabs as Brodie Lee vs. Dustin Rhodes went to war, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.45 ? a well-worked match. It was the first title opportunity of Dustin Rhodes's career. Championship gold always raises the stakes.
Rewind to 2023, when it was Dios Del Inframundo's first night in AEW, appearing on Collision, rated 5.47.

secondaries.text: Flash back to 2023, when Roderick Strong vs. Darby Allin met in a Tournament Match on Collision, rated 8.12 ? a genuinely great match.
On a Wednesday in 2020, back when Tay Conti arrived in AEW against Nyla Rose, appearing on Dynamite, rated 4.35.
